card.name: Di- inside salt names like dihydrochloride
card.fires_on: The short start "di" or "dis" right after a drug stem, where the salt name continues as dihydrochloride or disodium. Seen in drug names like balsalazide disodium and levocetirizine dihydrochloride.

modes.label: dis before odium
modes.description: The piece "dis" after balsalazide, leading into "odium" (disodium).

modes.label: di before hydrochloride
modes.description: The piece "di" after a drug stem such as cetirizine or sapropterin, leading into "hydrochloride".

card.writes: It pushes toward salt-name words such as sodium, sulfate and eth, which fit the chemical name that follows.
card.plain: It marks the "di" in a drug's salt name, such as the start of disodium or dihydrochloride.
